summary.en: Chinese coast guard and navy vessels are intensifying combat-readiness patrols, water-cannon drills and have deployed the carrier Liaoning into the western Pacific, prompting alarms from the Philippines, Taiwan and Japan. The Philippine Coast Guard is delivering fuel to Filipino fishermen at Scarborough Shoal, rescuing a ferry listing off Quezon Province and saving 58 passengers, and conducting a joint search-and-rescue exercise with the US Coast Guard in the West Philippine Sea. Taiwan reports Chinese coast guard ships harassing shipping and entering Dongsha restricted waters, while Chinese ships are suspected of surveying undersea cables near Japan and the Philippines. The UCDP recorded 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kinesiske kystvakts- og marineskip intensiverer beredskapspatruljer, vannkanonøvelser og har sendt hangarskipet Liaoning til det vestlige Stillehavet, noe som har vekket alarm hos Filippinene, Taiwan og Japan. Filippinsk kystvakt leverer drivstoff til filippinske fiskere ved Scarborough-revet, redder en ferge som kantret utenfor Quezon-provinsen og reddet 58 passasjerer, og gjennomfører en felles søk- og redningsøvelse med USAs kystvakt i Vest-Philippinehavet. Taiwan melder om kinesiske kystvaktskip som plager skipsfart og går inn i Dongsha-sperrede farvann, mens kinesiske skip mistenkes for å kartlegge undersjøiske kabler nær Japan og Filippinene. UCDP registrerte 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
